'''Neaed Fisto''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]]. The uncle of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]], and whom [[Eaden Vrill]] was named after, Neaed was the head of the [[Teräs Käsi/Legends|Teräs Käsi]] religious order [[Sälãi Käsi]]. It was said that Neaed was perhaps as strong in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] as his nephew. Neaed was the mentor of the Vrill family and Eaden's master. Around the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he was assassinated by [[Edge (Anomid)|Edge]], an [[Anomid/Legends|Anomid]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]], while buying time for Eaden and the other initiates to escape.<ref name="Shadow Games" />
